_note: 學習路徑內容第21批 #3／6：讓步副詞子句 concession clause（eng.t_mid.advcl.concession，會考級／中階）。although/though/even though 引導讓步子句，表示主句『儘管如此仍成立』的對比；子句可置句首（加逗號）或句後；用了 although 主句就不再加 but；even though 語氣較強。誘答鎖『用表原因/結果的連接詞取代讓步／although 與 but 並用／子句語序顛倒／誤解語意』等唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix ccl_）。

units.can_do: 我能用 although／though／even though 引導讓步子句表達對比（儘管…仍…），把子句放句首或句後，並知道不與 but 並用。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'although / though / even though' begins a clause that contrasts with the main clause: the main clause is still true in spite of it: 'Although it was cold, she went swimming.'
claims.verification_ref: although/though/even though 引導讓步子句，表主句儘管如此仍成立（Although it was cold, she went swimming）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The concession clause can come first (followed by a comma) or after the main clause: 'Although I was tired, I kept working.' = 'I kept working although I was tired.'
claims.verification_ref: 讓步子句可置句首（加逗號）或句後，意思相同；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: We do not add 'but' in the main clause when the sentence already begins with 'although/though': say 'Although it was late, we stayed.' not 'Although it was late, but we stayed.'
claims.verification_ref: 用了 although/though 就不在主句再加 but（標準英語不雙用連接詞）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'even though' is a stronger, more emphatic form of 'although': 'Even though he studied hard, he failed.'
claims.verification_ref: even though 是語氣較強的 although（Even though he studied hard, he failed）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 'although / though / even though' show a contrast: the main clause still happens in spite of the other part. Although it was raining, we played outside. 讓步子句表達『儘管…，仍然…』的對比。
Although it was raining, we played outside.　（儘管下著雨，我們還是在外面玩。although 引導讓步子句。）
The concession clause can go first (with a comma) or after the main clause, with the same meaning. She passed the test although she didn't study much. 讓步子句可放句首或句後，意思一樣。
She passed the test although she didn't study much.　（儘管她沒怎麼唸書，還是通過了考試。子句放在句後。）

Do not use 'but' in the main clause if you start with 'although/though'. 'even though' is just a stronger 'although'. Even though he was tired, he finished the race. 用了 although 就別再加 but；even though 語氣更強。
Even though he was tired, he finished the race.　（儘管他很累，他還是跑完了比賽。even though 語氣較強。）

practice.stem: 選正確：____ it was expensive, she bought the dress.（儘管很貴，她還是買了那件洋裝）
options: Although
Because
So
Therefore

distractor_rationales.Because: because 表原因，但這裡是『雖然貴、卻仍然買』的對比，要用讓步連接詞。
distractor_rationales.So: so 表結果、放在主句，不引導讓步子句。
distractor_rationales.Therefore: therefore 是『因此』的副詞連接詞，不引導子句，也不表讓步。

practice.feedback: Although it was expensive…：讓步子句表達『儘管…仍…』的對比。

practice.stem: 選出正確的句子：（儘管他生病了，還是來上學）
practice.answer: Although he was sick, he came to school.
options: Although he was sick, he came to school.
Although he was sick, but he came to school.
Although he was sick, so he came to school.
Although he was sick, because he came to school.

distractor_rationales.Although he was sick, but he came to sch: 用了 although 就不在主句再加 but，標準英語不雙用連接詞。
distractor_rationales.Although he was sick, so he came to scho: so 表結果，與 although 的讓步意不搭，且不雙用連接詞。
distractor_rationales.Although he was sick, because he came to: because 表原因，與 although 的讓步重複衝突。

practice.feedback: Although…, he came to school：用了 although 主句就不加 but。

practice.stem: 選正確：____ she is very young, she plays the piano beautifully.（儘管她很小，鋼琴卻彈得很美）
options: Even though
Because
Since
As soon as

distractor_rationales.Because: because 表原因，但這裡是『年紀小、卻彈得好』的對比，要用讓步連接詞。
distractor_rationales.Since: since 這裡作『因為』解，表原因，不符對比語氣。
distractor_rationales.As soon as: as soon as 表時間（一…就…），不符這裡的對比。

practice.feedback: Even though she is very young…：even though 引導語氣較強的讓步對比。

practice.stem: 選出正確的句子：（儘管電影很長，我們還是看得很開心）
practice.answer: Although the movie was long, we enjoyed it.
options: Although the movie was long, we enjoyed it.
Although long the movie was, we enjoyed it.
Although the movie long was, we enjoyed it.
Although was the movie long, we enjoyed it.

distractor_rationales.Although long the movie was, we enjoyed: 讓步子句要用正常語序（主詞 + 動詞 + 補語）：the movie was long。
distractor_rationales.Although the movie long was, we enjoyed: 語序錯誤；be 動詞 was 要放在主詞之後、形容詞之前：the movie was long。
distractor_rationales.Although was the movie long, we enjoyed: 這是問句的倒裝語序；讓步子句用直述語序 the movie was long。

practice.feedback: Although the movie was long…：讓步子句用正常的主詞 + 動詞語序。

practice.stem: Although she was invited, she didn't go to the party. 這句話的意思是？
practice.answer: 她雖然被邀請了，但她沒去派對。
options: 她雖然被邀請了，但她沒去派對。
因為她被邀請，所以她去了派對。
她沒被邀請，所以沒去派對。
只要她被邀請，她就會去派對。

distractor_rationales.因為她被邀請，所以她去了派對。: although 表讓步對比，不是『因為…所以…』，而且她其實沒去。
distractor_rationales.她沒被邀請，所以沒去派對。: was invited 是『被邀請了』，不是沒被邀請。
distractor_rationales.只要她被邀請，她就會去派對。: 這是條件（if）的意思，不是 although 的讓步對比。

practice.feedback: Although she was invited, she didn't go：儘管被邀請，仍然沒去（對比）。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: Although it was raining, they kept playing football.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：Although（讓步）、句首子句後的逗號、kept playing、句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。讓步子句後略停、主句句尾下收。

lines.text: Even though I was afraid, I tried again.
lines.intonation: afraid 後略停、again 句尾下收

lines.text: Although she was tired, she kept smiling.
lines.intonation: tired 後略停、smiling 句尾下收
